reviews.text:
I used Candy Paws for approximately a year and had a fantastic experience. My dog was primarily walked by Erik, and occasionally walked by the other walkers too.

Erik was always on time, as confirmed by my in-house dog camera. They walked my dog CeCe for a minimum of 3 hours every time, so I always got my money's worth and sometimes more. Not to mention it's only about $30 for 3 hours of walking which is a pretty crazy low price.

My dog absolutely loved the walkers and was extremely excited when they'd show up, which indicated to me she was always treated very well on the walks.

They track if your dog peed, pooed, was provided with water, and the route over which they walked for that day. All of the information is provided to you instantly over an e-mail report card which gave me peace of mind while I was at work that everything was going okay and that my dog had received good stimulation/exercise.

I would recommend these folks 1000 times over. Thank you Hollie, Erik, and others, for all of your work over the last year!

I was traveling to Toronto and needed help with my dog. The owner was super communicative and went above and beyond to assist me and my unconventional request. She answered all of my questions and put my mind at ease. I go everywhere with my dog and I’m well versed in quality care, it was only green flags with this team.  Unfortunately, because of the tornadoes in the mid west, we didn't get to use their services but I wanted to shout out the excellent customer care.

I am so grateful to have met Hollie from Candie Paws! She is kind, caring, patient and knowledgeable! I have been doing private lessons with my 1 year old maltipoo Feta and notice improvements with him each session. He recently has had some health issues, sadly his vet was not very helpful but Hollie was right there to help in any way she could! I couldn’t be more appreciative and look forward to continuing sessions with her. Feta thanks his friend Hollie ❤️
